I replied to Tobias in his thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from Priyanka's messages in that channel on 3 Sep 2025. Her first update said label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her resolution note at 18:43 that day said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

If Tobias needs a street address rather than the depot name, the channel doesn't have one. I only read that channel, which he's a member of.
